name: Detroit
living: the two tiger statues on the scoreboard get a slow warm rim-light glint, their eyes glowing softly
the scoreboard screen's lamps buzz with an occasional soft flicker and its numbers update after a home run
the glowing crown bands on the round Renaissance-style towers pulse slowly in violet and blue
art deco skyscraper windows flicker on and off one by one
a red aircraft-warning light blinks on the tallest spire
amber backlit clouds drift slowly across the dusk sky
light-tower lamp banks breathe softly, moths drifting through the cones
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
